Profile

Physics-led questions.
Data-led answers.

My work connects physical modelling with modern machine learning. I design neural networks for parameter inference, quantify what models do not know, and test them against the messy reality of astronomical observations.

Research atlas

Three scales.
One methodology.

Select a research area to see how modelling, learning, and inference come together.

01 / 03

Inferring the invisible from distorted light.

Neural networks turn multi-channel Hyper Suprime-Cam images into estimates of lens and source parameters. Bayesian models extend that inference to uncertainties and covariances.

  • Multi-channel imaging
  • Bayesian uncertainty
  • Real-data validation

02 / 03

Recognising change in a moving universe.

Current postdoctoral work focuses on machine-learning methods for finding and classifying transient astronomical sources in the data stream of Rubin LSST.

  • Detection
  • Classification
  • Survey-scale data

03 / 03

Testing dark-matter ideas across cosmic distance.

Gravitational-lensing studies probe primordial black-hole abundance through the microlensing parallax of gamma-ray bursts.

  • GRB microlensing
  • Parallax constraints
  • Physical interpretation
